name: When the Rosemary Blooms
overview: Anna, a doctor at the district polyclinic, works hard to feed her family: a drinking husband and a schoolboy son. However, no matter how much the heroine fights, life does not get better – there is not enough money for anything, and there are constant quarrels at home. Son Sasha is trying his best to help his mother, even though he is still a child. Sasha knows a sure remedy for failures: the rosemary is about to bloom in the swamp - he and his mother will make a wish on it, and everything will be fine with them.…
